facts.fact: 本章叙述者是 Elise：她是 swan king（the great swan）的女儿、Cynghal 帝国的公主，母亲已死。
facts.anchor: Princess Elise, daughter of the great swan, princess of the Cynghal empire, daughter to a dead queen

facts.fact: Synod 在不到十年前裁定：比武的残暴会损害女人的健康，所以女人不该看。
facts.anchor: for the Synod had declared not a decade earlier that the brutality might damage a woman’s health

facts.fact: 幼时她被允许和弟弟 Conrin、Gaisa 一起坐在 Galenish 看台看比武，如今不再被允许。
facts.anchor: she had been allowed to sit with her younger brothers, Conrin and Gaisa, to watch in the Galenish stands

facts.fact: 长兄 Conrin 二十一岁，率自己挑选的队伍上场，全队用银色系，即 grey guard。
facts.anchor: At twenty-one, he led his selected host onto the field

facts.fact: Egil 的撤退是假动作：他算准哥哥们会先追他，事先与另一队想夺荣耀的 Cynghal 贵族结盟，从侧翼夹击 Conrin 与 Gaisa。
把她从窗台拽回房里的是她最喜欢的哥哥 Isen，排行第二。
Elise 蓝底织锦上有十三只天鹅，代表 Liran 王所有活着的与死去的子女；这幅织锦绣了两年。
facts.anchor: There were thirteen swans on her blue canvas.

facts.fact: 父亲八年仍未原谅她；她自认从来就不该是做王后的人，而这一点父亲也知道，甚至几乎记不得她。
facts.anchor: ‘I was never meant to be a queen,’ said Elise softly, rubbing the stone dust from the side of her skirts. ‘And father knows it. It’s been eight years, Isen, and he still has not forgiven me.’
